To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cell type of the donor cell and the genotype of the donor cells and cloned embryo affect the efficiency of mouse somatic cell cloning.
the cell type of the donor cell and the genotype of the recipient embryo affect the efficiency of mouse somatic cell cloning.
the developmental ability of somatic cell clones is improved when the donor cell type and/or genotype are chosen appropriately.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an efficient and reliable system of somatic cell nuclear transfer in mice.
the development of a new method for the production of transgenic animals by somatic cell cloning.
the development of an efficient method to produce transgenic mice by using somatic cell cloning.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cell type of the donor cell is the most important factor for successful cloning, followed by donor genotype.
the efficiency of mouse somatic cell cloning is affected by a combination of the cell type and the genotype of the donor cells.
the efficiency of mouse somatic cell cloning can be increased by choosing the appropriate combination of cell type and donor genotype.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the most efficient clones were obtained from the combination of cumulus cells and (129 × J1)F1 cells.
the most efficient cloning is obtained from the cumulus cells of the 129 × JF 1 genotype.

the best results were obtained when (1) the donor cells were in a state of cell-cycle synchrony (i.e., at G0/Gl), (2) the donor genotype matched the recipient genotype, and (3) the donor cells came from the Sertoli cell type.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to obtain a high efficiency of cloning, the donor cell type and genotype should be carefully selected.
somatic cell cloning is not a one-size-fits-all process.
it is not enough to clone from the best cell type; the best combination of genotype and cell type is required for efficient somatic cell cloning.
